managedCronJobs.purpose: Daily re-pricing of the collection's market values; appends one point per day to the value-over-time history. Paid amounts stay as recorded.

Daily audit of the card catalog against the complete Lorcana card universe (LorcanaJSON, Lorcast, DL Promos): inserts newly released or newly sourced printings so every card can be scanned, searched, and added. Existing cards, ownership, and prices are never touched.
Continues the resumable Pokémon catalog download (official Pokémon TCG API) a chunk per day until the catalog is complete; no-ops as a light re-check once complete.
Continues the resumable Magic: The Gathering catalog download (Scryfall) a chunk per day until complete.
Continues the resumable Star Wars: Unlimited catalog download (Fantasy Flight official card API) a chunk per day until complete.

Continues the resumable Funko Pop! catalog download (open-source funko-pop-data dataset, scraped from Pop Price Guide / HobbyDB) a chunk per day until complete; no-ops as a light re-check once complete.
Continues the resumable Lego catalog download (Rebrickable official bulk data: sets.csv.gz + themes.csv.gz) a chunk per day until the catalog is complete; no-ops as a light re-check once complete.
